developerModeDescription: Developer Mode unlocks developer and internal surfaces — Developer Tools, the standalone Tester reference, and mod UI. It is off by default and only changes what you can reach, never ordinary product behaviour.
testerUnavailableBody: The standalone Tester launch reference is surfaced only when the nimi.tester app is admitted as a developer-only app in the platform registry.
testerStandaloneBody: Tester is now a standalone Nimi App generated by app-tools. Desktop keeps the developer reference and launches the app through Runtime; it no longer embeds the tester product UI.
testerLaunchReady: Runtime accepted the standalone Tester launch.
testerLaunchBlocked: Runtime blocked the standalone Tester launch at {{step}}.
